rca of the issue: Original bug: platform number +34919932652 played 'no disponible' on inbound. RCA: (a) Vapi credential 'byo-sip-trunk' only had the Zadarma SIP gateway with inboundEnabled=false (outbound-only), so inbound SIP INVITEs from Zadarma were rejected by Vapi; (b) the phone-number row had no server webhook configured so Vapi had no assistant-request destination; (c) no tenant_numbers {platform:true,country:'ES'} row existed, so even if the webhook fired, assistant_request() would return UNAVAILABLE. Fix verified: vapi.enable_inbound() PATCHes gateways=[sip.zadarma.com outbound-only, 185.45.152.0/24, 185.45.154.0/24, 185.45.155.0/24, 195.122.19.0/24, 15.235.128.70/32, 31.31.222.201/32 — all inbound-only] + patches phone-number server {url,headers:x-vapi-secret}; PUT upserts tenant_numbers {platform:true, country:'ES', tenant_id:admin, phone_number_id, status:'activo', inbound_agent_id}. Webhook assistant-request now resolves the ES agent and returns build_assistant() with the Marta greeting. Simulated call test confirmed firstMessage='Hola, OpenFactura.es, te atiende Marta…'. User should now hear the agent instead of 'no disponible'.
